paper: PCantorSim: Accelerating Parallel Architecture Simulation through Fractal-Based Sampling
motivating_problem: Reduce the cost of parallel-workload simulation without discarding phase structure.

proof_or_performance_argument: Accuracy and speed comparisons against longer simulation across parallel workloads.
practical_connection_and_breadth: Direct architecture-simulation workflow with synchronization-sensitive workloads.

figure_table_roles: Sampling schematic and error/speedup plots carry the argument.
relation_to_current_work: Shows TACO expects empirical representativeness and speed evidence for acceleration claims; this paper instead makes a bounded certificate claim.
